title: Minehut
description: Explore the largest independent free server network in Minecraft, with in-game lobby minigames and SMP.
body:
Minehut is a popular Minecraft server hosting provider that allows users to create and manage their own Java servers for free. It features a large, integrated network with a central lobby, offering easy setup, pre-installed plugins, and support for thousands of player-run, community-driven servers.

The central hub regularly has lobby minigames, events and Minehut has also recently launched a brand new official SMP server!
